Smithbridge Asset Management Inc decreased its stake in Apple Computer Inc Com (AAPL) by 9.36% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Smithbridge Asset Management Inc sold 3,862 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 37,392 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.27 million, down from 41,254 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Smithbridge Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Apple Computer Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $911.56B market cap company.
